claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now, based on aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, with the telehealth discharge planning weakness handled through release documentation disclosure rather than a resolved issue or approved mitigation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.

Certification is compliant only if the telehealth discharge planning weakness is explicitly disclosed as a material limitation for the named launch use case, or is covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed approval.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the current evaluation batch and explicit disclosure of the telehealth discharge planning limitation.
Provide any approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the telehealth discharge planning weakness if certification is being sought without full resolution.
Provide the current launch approval artifact, if any, tied to the present retrieval configuration and current eval batch.
specific_concerns: The controlling policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before launch, but no evidence shows the current model card or release documentation was actually updated.
The telehealth discharge planning slice is below threshold and regressed relative to the prior approved release, which makes the limitation material for a named launch use case.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot support current certification.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or approved risk acceptance under the stated policy.
The actor's recommendation is effectively conditional on future documentation changes, but the packet does not contain admissible evidence that those conditions are already satisfied.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That documentation-based certification is supported for this release without producing the current model card or release artifact showing the required disclosure and current evaluation results.
Any implication that prior approval or informal monitoring materially closes the current policy gap.
